rv.q: More than anything, Andrew Panton's production for Dundee Rep and the National Theatre of Scotland is one big, happy laugh.
Just sayin', but oh, dearie me, what a wonderful flight of fancy this is.

cn.t: Critics praise this musical revival of the cult '94 sitcom for its deliriously silly pantomime energy, brilliant songs, and Beano-esque plot, with Cumming and Masson delivering high-flying entertainment.
